name: How to Scan a Document to PDF
description: Scan a document with your camera or an existing photo — automatic edge detection and perspective correction, free, no upload required.

step.name: Take a photo or choose one from your gallery
step.text: Tap Take Photo to use your camera, or drop/choose an existing photo of a document.

step.name: Review the detected crop
step.text: The document's edges are detected automatically. Drag any corner to adjust, or choose Skip if the photo doesn't need cropping.

step.name: Confirm and save as PDF
step.text: Add more pages the same way if needed, pick a filter (Grayscale by default), then save your scan as a PDF.
